_about: RC16 guard (tests/priceConfig.test.mjs): top-level numeric constants in src/lib/ that are NOT price rules, each file with why. A new numeric constant in lib/ fails the guard until it moves to config/pricing.json (or config/*.json) or is added here with a reason. A name under ruleNumbers behaves like a rule number and says which engine wave moves it to config. The price modules are not listed: they are held to the stricter list in the test.
